chunks: And will admit them into the Garden, having made it known to them.

key_terms.الْجَنَّةَ: Paradise, the abode of eternal bliss
key_terms.عَرَّفَهَا: He made it known / acquainted them with it

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that Allah made Paradise known to the believers before admitting them?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the divine grace of 'ta'rif' (making known), where Allah reveals the true nature of Paradise to believers during their earthly life, fostering spiritual anticipation and recognition. This pre-entry knowledge serves as a psychological and spiritual preparation, ensuring that the reward is not merely a surprise but a fulfilled promise understood by the faithful. It underscores the intimate relationship between divine knowledge and the believer's ultimate destiny.
